concept: One we stayed in. One we built. (Real vs Brick, told by the parent behind the camera)
font_notes: Weights: Playfair Display 700 italic and 900 italic; Montserrat 800 (value lines, URL bug) and 600 (disclaimer); others 400. Copy rules: say 'Riviera Resort brick model'; never 'set', 'kit', 'box', 'included', 'official', 'replica', price, Disney, LEGO or BrickLink in our own copy. The only LEGO mention is the disclaimer (and the booklet cover's own small subtitle as incidental art).

voice.notes: One narrator: the parent who took the photos (never seen, behind the camera). Warm, smiling, first-person, like showing friends the holiday photos; softer on the memory line (vo3), a little conspiratorial on 'home', proud on the product name, playful on 'shelf' and on the kid quote, warm and confident on the CTA. Generate every line as its own clip, trim leading/trailing silence, and place the first audible sample exactly at 'start'. Each clip must fit inside [start, start+max_dur]; max_dur already carries >= 0.3 s slack over a 3.4 words/s budget. Only French flourish: ff_siwis 'Voilà !' on the 8.00 drop. Measured with kokoro-onnx v1.0 at speed 1.05 (trimmed): vo1 0.92 s, vo2 0.77, vo3 1.86, vo4 1.46, vo5 0.55 (ff_siwis 1.0), vo6 1.69, vo7 1.32, vo8 1.29, vo9 1.00, vo10 1.29, vo11 1.04, vo12 1.92, vo13 2.19 - all inside their windows. Numbers are spelled out in the TTS input; the URL uses tts_text (phonemizes as bɹˈɪkkˈuːdəl dˈɑːt kˈɑːm).

music.style: French Riviera pop-house, 120 BPM, D major (1 beat = 0.5 s, 1 bar = 2 s; bar n starts at 2(n-1) s; every scene cut is on a beat). Chords D – Bm – G – A, one per bar, looping. Instruments (numpy): plucky nylon-style synth arp on 8ths; accordion-style musette pad (two detuned saws ±6 cents, lowpass ~1.8 kHz, 5 Hz tremolo); whistle-like sine lead with 5 Hz vibrato, hook motif A4–D5–F#5–E5 | D5–B4–A4 (2 bars); glockenspiel sparkles; round sine/triangle bass on 8ths; soft kick, claps on 2 and 4, shaker; brick clicks used as percussion (they come from the SFX track). Music ducks ~8 dB under every VO clip (mix.py does the side-chain). Master target -14 LUFS, -1 dBTP. The last half-bar resolves into the intro arp so the loop back to 0.00 is seamless.

sections.notes: Intro: low-passed (~1.2 kHz) pluck arp + a single glock D6 on 0.00 under the shutter. No drums. A pluck/glock accent on 1.50 under the brick snap.
Memory: the accordion pad enters with the whistle motif (nostalgic), soft shaker on 8ths. Still no kick.

Riser under the print push and brickify: 16th-note plucks, filtered-noise sweep (lowpass 900 Hz -> 8 kHz), snare roll 1/8 (5.0-6.0) -> 1/16 (6.0-7.0) -> 1/32 (7.0-7.5), pitch rising. Everything cuts dead at 7.50.
STOP-DOWN #1: total music silence except one quiet sustained glock A5; the brick-click cascade (SFX) carries the transformation. A reverse-cymbal suck-in 7.70-8.00 at -18 dB.

DROP on 'Voilà !' (bar 5 downbeat): crash, sub boom, four-on-the-floor kick, claps 2+4, bass octaves, accordion chord stabs on the off-beats, whistle hook. Ducked under vo6/vo7. Clap accents line up with the rally snaps at 11.50 and 13.00.
Booklet: lighter groove - kick on 1 and 3 only, claps, pad, pluck; whistle drops out so the page flips read.
Build montage: full kick returns; the 7 brick clicks (SFX, rising pitch) sit on the 8ths like a hi-hat; bass walks up D-E-F#-A. Completion chime at 19.50.
Kick drops out; pad + pluck + a music-box statement of the motif under 'pass me the red one!'.
STOP-DOWN #2: silence (comic beat after the kid quote) with a reverse cymbal 21.60-22.00.
Final chorus / CTA: crash + full D chord on 22.00, accordion takes the hook, full groove, heavily ducked under vo12 and vo13.
Outro: final D-major chord on 28.00 ringing, thin pad + pluck, kick out.
Loop bridge: downward whoosh (SFX), low-pass closes back to ~1.2 kHz and the pluck arp pickup leads straight into bar 1 on replay.

captions.style: Designed captions: every VO line is already rendered once as designed on-screen type in its scene (vo[].caption == 'designed', vo[].caption_text = what is shown; the matching scene text item carries the same words). Do NOT draw a second subtitle for designed lines - no word appears twice. Entrances land within 2 frames of the matching VO word (use the placed VO clip's start; per-word timings may be derived from the clip's duration). Numbers are shown as digits (94, 1,746, 6–8, Step 1) and the URL always as 'brickcoodle.com'. Fallback style (only for a line whose caption == 'pill'; none in this cut): Montserrat 800 52 px sentence case, white on a #14304F pill at 85% (radius 22, padding 14/26), active word #F29A2E, max 2 lines of ~26 characters, 120 ms fade + 8 px rise.
captions.position: Designed captions sit where each scene's text item says. Fallback pill: left edge x 80, max width 860, bottom-anchored at y 1480, never below y 1495 or right of x 940.

variant_4x5: 1080x1350 feed cut from the same scene graph: draw the 9:16 layout and crop the band y 200-1550 (translateY -200). Every key text block sits at 9:16 y 290-1495, so it lands at 4:5 y 90-1295. Exceptions: (1) s1 and s10 split screen - keep two equal halves by moving the divider to 4:5 y 675 (9:16 y 875): each half is 675 px tall, re-crop both images around the same focal points (real canopy / brick canopy) with the same source-rect limits, and move the chip + hook-line block up 85 px with the divider. (2) Full-frame backgrounds (gradients, cloud plate, stud grid, cream table) are regenerated to fill 1350 px instead of cropped. (3) Confetti spawn/fall ranges scale 0.7 vertically. Everything else (prints, window, cards, model placements, end-card stack) keeps its 9:16 coordinates minus 200.
